name: Ranger War Falcons: each active falcon generates 1 Focus per second
contract: Follow-up of #481 (PR #5285). 680278 'War Falcon' has the aura text 'You have a War Falcon active! Generating 1 Focus per second.$?s705098[ Reduces damage taken by ${$w3}%.][]'. Effects 0 and 1 are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER from TARGET_UNIT_CASTER with radius index 12 (100 yd): a dummy counter and SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE, MiscValue 2 (Focus), BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1 every 1000 ms. An owner area aura from the caster reaches only the caster's owner, so its caster is the falcon, and SPELL_ATTR3_DOT_STACKING_RULE keeps one aura per falcon. No spell triggers 680278 and no War Falcon template carried it. Falcon Dive 806341 is a self-cast with two SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON effects of creature 50393 'War Falcon' (SummonProperties 61, a guardian) for DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, and costs no Focus. The Ranger's own Focus regeneration is suppressed (allow_regeneration false), so its Focus changes only through spell energizes. Expected: no Focus without a falcon; with two falcons active each falcon wears 680278, the Ranger carries the War Falcon presence and gains 2 Focus per second (about 10 in 5 s); after the falcons expire the presence and the gain stop. Before the fix the falcons wear no 680278 and the Ranger's Focus stays 0. Wingman's -2% per falcon stays on its own aura script (ranger-wingman-war-falcons).

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
CONTROL: no Focus without a War Falcon

The War Falcons leave after 12 seconds
The War Falcon presence ends with the falcons
No Focus after the falcons expire
